info.name: EcoTrack Microservices
info.description:
Complete API collection for EcoTrack Microservices - Environmental Monitoring & Sustainability Management System. All requests go through API Gateway on port 8090.

## Setup:
1. Register a user
2. Login and copy the token
3. Set the `token` variable with your JWT token
4. All authenticated requests will use it automatically
